findings.title: The murder window draws the living once, and Open the incident opens on a student who died while it stood
findings.what_happens: The lists, the trap box's default, the rooms note and the statistic's values are built from livingStudentsForGm, the projects and the tokens at open (90, 149-155, 191-198). The window has no keepLive and its render hook listens only to its own selects. Its answer goes to openMurder, whose guards are the Eclipse, a running incident and both actors existing (452-488); nothing there asks whether killer or victim is dead to the GMs. So a death recorded while the window is open (the Students list's Kill, another GM, a Despair Call) leaves that student in both lists, and Open the incident writes a fresh incident and sends the opening roll for them.
findings.failure_scenario: A GM opens Murder, a second GM records the chosen victim's death from the Students list, and the first GM's Open the incident starts an incident whose victim is already dead, with an opening roll sent to the killer.
findings.expected: the lists follow the deaths (keepLive on actors and drpgDeathsChanged), and openMurder refuses a killer or victim dead to the GMs, with a word
findings.refutation_tried: Read openMurder whole from 440 to 607 for any isDeadForGm, isDeceased, living or alive test: none (the only hit is a comment at 508). freshIncidentState (374) writes the ids as given. The murder window is not single-instance (no alreadyOpen, 213-216), so it can stand behind other windows. The rooms note is the softer half: it is redrawn on each select change (278-288) but not on a token move.
findings.probe: game.drpg.murderDialog(); while it stands, game.drpg.deathDialog({ actor: <the preselected victim> }) and Record the death; then Open the incident in the first window; read murderState().victimId and isDeadForGm of that actor

findings.title: The tracker does not hear item writes: the Cleaning Tool line and every clean-up DC stay wrong after the killer readies or puts away a tool
findings.what_happens: At Stage 6 the region prints the killer's readied Cleaning Tool and its tier (DRPG.Cleanup.gmTool: 'is readied, so the killer rolls with advantage, and each DC below is already {tier} lower') and each trace's DC, which subtracts that tier (cleanupDc). Readying or putting away an item writes only the item's module flag (toggleEquipped, trustedWrite on the item, 360-361), which fires updateItem. keepLive's watch names actors, tokens, the murderState setting and drpgCastChanged; ITEM_HOOKS are opt-in (live.mjs:72, 309) and not asked. The region stands until some watched write lands.
findings.failure_scenario: At Stage 6 the killer's player readies a Tier 2 rag from the sheet; the GM's tracker goes on saying the killer has no Cleaning Tool and lists each trace two points too high until the next Sanity spend redraws it.
findings.expected: the tracker also watches items (watch.items), as its comment says it watches everything it prints
findings.refutation_tried: Looked for an actor write in the readying road that would fire updateActor: toggleEquipped writes items only (316-366). live.mjs listenFor (304-311) adds ITEM_HOOKS only when watch.items. A clean-up attempt does spend Sanity (an actor write) and so redraws, which bounds the gap to the time before the next attempt - the attempt the GM is about to judge.
findings.probe: open the tracker at Stage 6 with a Cleaning Tool on the killer; toggle it with use-items.mjs toggleEquipped; read the tracker's .drpg-incident-live text before and after a 1 s wait

findings.title: Silence now is drawn once per tracker copy and stays after the voice was moved or the body announced; its press does nothing and says nothing
findings.what_happens: The footer is built when the copy opens (silence read at 703) and keepLive replaces the content region, not the footer (601-603). Another GM's Silence now, or the body's announcement (isDeceased), changes none of the signature's two fields (stage, selfInflicted), so the copy is not reopened. A press calls silenceDeadNow, which answers false for a death already silenced or known (982), and the tracker reopens without the button and without a word.
findings.failure_scenario: Two GMs watch a Stage 6; one presses Silence now; the other's tracker still offers it, and its press only makes the button disappear.
findings.expected: a cast change reopens the copy when the footer's set would differ, as a stage change does
findings.refutation_tried: drpgCastChanged is watched, so the region redraws, but incidentSignature (605-607) ignores the cast. gm-students.mjs:422 redraws its own Silence now row on the same hook, so the Students list stays true where the tracker does not.

findings.title: Four questions about an incident or a body stay open after it moved on, and their yes then does nothing and says nothing; killerFell's sibling closes itself since E68 T6
findings.surface: They ran out; The incident's victim died; Students found a body; End the murder (the tracker's question)
findings.control: End the incident / Move to Stage 6 / Announce / End the murder
findings.where: scripts/murder-rules.mjs:2415-2435; scripts/death.mjs:594-614 with murder-rules.mjs:2928; scripts/body.mjs:931-943 with 312; scripts/murder-ui.mjs:793-801
findings.what_happens: Each is a drpgConfirm or drpgWindow awaited with no listener. The two-killer question of checkVictimSpent writes Stage 6 against the incident it read and returns false when that fails (2434-2435). offerStageSix's yes calls beginResolution, which returns null when the stage is no longer incident (2928). The pending-body prompt continues past a row the discovery window's announcement dropped (943, 312). None tells the GM. killerFell (3137-3149) is the same question shape and closes its window on the murderState setting's update; the comment there records that the open window was found by the suite and answered a later test's question. The tracker's own End question is the fourth: open when another road closes the incident, its yes runs endMurder on no incident.
findings.failure_scenario: A GM is asked 'The incident's victim died - Move to Stage 6?', meanwhile ends the incident from the tracker, then presses Move to Stage 6 on the question still on screen: nothing happens and nothing says why.
findings.expected: each closes, unanswered, when what it asks about is gone (as killerFell's does), or its yes says that it is
findings.refutation_tried: Looked for a render hook or a closeOpen call on these windows: none (2415-2428, 594-611, 931-941, 793-799). For the body prompt, the road that empties the row while the prompt stands: the primary is the one browser that may announce (discoveryHere 176-181), and the discovery window's note points the GM there from the prompt (1148-1149), so the same GM can do it with the prompt still open. For checkVictimSpent, the victim's later updates do not ask again while it is open (victimCheck holds, 3234-3240). What endMurder writes on no incident (closeIncident with state null) is not traced here (not_established).
findings.probe: open a direct murder with an accomplice, drain the victim to spent so the question opens on the primary; close the incident from the tracker; press End the incident; read the notifications and murderState()

findings.title: End the chapter is drawn once: its counts, its shut boxes and the Final Truth warning stand, and its own Back up the case leaves 'last backup: never' on screen

findings.what_happens: The form is chapterEndForm over counts read before the window opens (427-465) and the backup reminder (475). The render hook wires the backup button and nothing else; there is no keepLive. The button saves the file and writes lastBackupAt (gm-stores.mjs:2311) and the reminder beside it keeps the date it was drawn with. A box drawn at 0 is disabled (320-325) and stays disabled when a Key Remnant, a Faint trace or an unidentified bullet appears while the window stands; the end then runs with that box false. applyChapterEnd refuses a moved clock (the opened mark) but not moved counts.
